name: Mineral Resources Limited
summary: Mineral Resources Limited, together with subsidiaries, provides mining services in Australia, China, and internationally. It operates through Mining Services, Iron Ore, Lithium, Energy, and Other segments. The company offers mining services contractors, and trades in mining services; pit-to-ship solutions to the resources sectors; design and construction of mineral processing facilities; transport and logistics services comprising supply chain, road haulage, autonomous road train, and transshipping services; manufacturing of equipment and parts for the mining industry; rehabilitation services; and engineering and construction services.
